name: Mastered Palm
description: Deliver a settled palm blow with the shoulders square and the legs already driving through the target.

name: Settled Guard
description: Sink the weight into the stance so that blows against the arms and chest lose their force.

name: Balanced Stride
description: Move with the weight always over the feet so the next blow can be thrown from any step.

name: Bone Surge
description: Draw qi into the long bones of the limbs so that blows and lifts land with denser force.

name: Weight Drop
description: Drop the body's whole weight through a fist or elbow onto the target from above.

name: Pulse Press
description: Press a pulse of qi into the target through a palm so its arms stiffen and cannot rise.

name: Brawn Tide
description: Let a slow tide of qi rise through the user's body until every limb works with greater force.

name: Staggering Blow
description: Land one blow so heavy that the target reels and loses its footing and its guard together.

name: Overbearing Force
description: Bear down on the target with the full weight of the body until it can neither strike nor flee.

name: Pestle Fist
description: Drive the fist straight down and up again like a pestle in a mortar to batter the target.

name: Beating Guard
description: Take blows on the forearms in a steady cadence so that none finds the body.

name: Cadence Footfall
description: Step in time with the pulse of the blows so that each footfall adds to the force of the next.

name: Cadence Surge
description: Match the breath to the beat of the blows so qi builds in the arms with every cycle.

name: Blow Weigh
description: Judge the weight of each landed blow by its echo through the arm to measure the target's frame.

name: Clubbing Palm
description: Swing the open palm like a club in a flat arc to crack against the target's side.

name: Echoing Blow
description: Land a blow whose shock rolls on through the target and jolts its balance a moment later.

name: Flex Release
description: Flex the whole body at once to burst a binding of rope or qi from the user or a bound ally.

name: Hammering Torrent
description: Rain a ceaseless torrent of fist blows on one point until the target's guard collapses.

name: Shattering Beat
description: Gather the beat of all prior blows into one point and drive it through the target's guard and bone.

name: Outreach Palm
description: Throw the palm so the qi on its surface carries the blow a hand's breadth beyond the skin.

name: Outer Brace
description: Spread qi a hand's breadth beyond the body to blunt a blow before it touches the skin.

name: Wide Step
description: Take a wide planted step that carries the body and its field of qi across the gap together.

name: Reach Appraisal
description: Read the push of a target's strength through the qi field before its body has moved.

name: Force Extension
description: Throw the force of a fist forward along the arm and loose it as a blow at short range.

name: Reach Surge
description: Spread qi out to the fingertips and beyond so strikes and grips gain length and weight.

name: Unbound Fist
description: Drive a fist whose force leaves the hand and strikes deep into a target several paces away.

name: Squeezing Press
description: Close the qi field about a cluster of targets and squeeze until all are pressed and shaken.

name: Colossus Stand
description: Stand with the frame swollen and rooted so that blows break on a body of immense mass.

name: Giant Step
description: Cover a great distance in a single heavy stride that shakes the ground under the foot.

name: Great Palm
description: Swing a huge open palm with the whole oversized frame turning behind it.

name: Great Shove
description: Shove with the entire frame so the target is driven back many paces and cannot recover.

name: Mass Press
description: Press down on a target with the full mass of the frame until it is held flat.

name: Size Sense
description: Measure by touch how the target's mass compares with the user's own frame.

name: Colossus Blow
description: Bring a fist down from above the head with the frame's whole mass to crush the target.

name: Towering Guard
description: Rise to full height with arms wide and take every blow on a body that fills the space.

name: Titan Surge
description: Swell the muscles of the whole body with qi until every movement gains a giant's weight.

name: Colossus Crush
description: Seize the target in a great fist and crush it against the ground with the frame's whole mass.

name: Towering Rebuke
description: Turn aside a heavy blow with the forearm and answer with a fist that carries the same weight.

name: Pillar Palm
description: Thrust a palm down the line of the body with the other arm braced beside it like a second pillar.

name: Pillar Bracing
description: Stand with the arms and legs set in matched pairs so that force passes through them as it would a column.

name: Paired Tread
description: Move both feet in matched beats so the weight is never caught on a single leg.

name: Pillar Surge
description: Run qi evenly up both legs and both arms so the paired limbs share an equal surge of force.

name: Twin Strike
description: Land a fist and then an elbow in a single paired motion on one point of the target.

name: Pair Grip
description: Seize the target with both hands at two points so it cannot twist away from either.

name: Pillar Rebound
description: Take a blow on one arm and send its force back along the other into the attacker.

name: Twinfold Crush
description: Bring both fists down on the target together so the paired force doubles inside its guard.

name: Paired Rebuke
description: Catch a heavy strike between both forearms and return it doubled through the same line.

name: Sinking Grip
description: Take hold of the target and let it sink into the user's grip like a stone into still water.

name: Drawing Stand
description: Hold the stance deep and level so any blow is drawn in and spent without moving the body.

name: Pour Shove
description: Pour the stored weight of the body forward through both hands in a single heavy shove.

name: Settle Pace
description: Settle down on each step so force gathers in the legs before it is loosed in the next.

name: Belly Draw
description: Draw qi down into the belly and thighs until the body holds more force than it can yet spend.

name: Held Mass
description: Hold the target under a pressure that rises as the user's stored force fills.

name: Spillover Blow
description: Let the stored force spill over in a single blow that carries more than the arm could throw alone.

name: Stored Surge
description: Open the stored well of qi and let it run into the limbs of the user or an ally.

name: Brimmed Crush
description: Release all the stored force at once in a fist that crushes whatever it falls upon.

name: Holding Press
description: Press the target down with a calm and constant weight that drains its strength to rise.

name: Giant Palm
description: Swing a palm of oversized reach with the opposite fist ready to follow it.

name: Giant Guard
description: Raise both arms in a wide frame so the body behind them is hidden from the blow.

name: Mirror Stride
description: Step with both feet in opposing arcs so the body turns without losing its mass.

name: Giant Sense
description: Feel through the qi field how large and heavy the force bearing down on the user truly is.

name: Giant Hands
description: Clap both great hands about the target and squeeze so it is held and hurt at once.

name: Giant Surge
description: Swell both hands and arms with qi until they can lift and crush as a giant's would.

name: Giantfall
description: Bring both fists down together from a great height so the whole weight lands as one blow.

name: Twinned Heave
description: Seize a target in both hands and heave it overhead to throw it far from the user.

name: Sworn Hand
description: Strike with a palm that has been sworn to steadiness so the blow lands without waver.

name: Oathbound Guard
description: Hold the arms and legs fixed as an oath is held so that no blow moves them.

name: Bearing Stridework
description: Take a step along a chosen bearing and hold the line without drifting from it.

name: Sworn Surge
description: Speak the oath under the breath and feel qi gather in the arms and legs to keep it.

name: Sworn Clamp
description: Take hold of a limb and keep the grip as a sworn thing that is not let go.

name: Bearing Weigh
description: Read the direction and weight of the force coming at the user and fix a bearing against it.

name: Oathbound Blow
description: Throw a blow bound to the oath so that it falls where the user has sworn it to fall.

name: Sworn Press
description: Press on the target with a steady oath-held weight so that it cannot rise or strike.

name: Bearing Surge
description: Pour qi into the user or an ally along a held bearing so strength stays steady and full.

name: Clear Bearing
description: Steady the breath and clear the shaking of fear or poison from the limbs of the user or an ally.

name: Oathfall Blow
description: Let the full weight of the sworn stance fall into a single blow that breaks a guard.

name: Sworn Torrent
description: Hurl the sworn force out in a wide wave that strikes every target within reach of the user.

name: Planted Palm
description: Plant the foot and send the palm out from it so the ground itself seems to push.

name: Foot Brace
description: Press the planted foot into the ground and let the leg carry the whole force of a blow.

name: Rooted Pace
description: Advance by sliding the planted foot forward so the weight is never lifted from the earth.

name: Planted Surge
description: Draw qi up through the planted foot and through the whole body until every strike grows firmer.

name: Planted Rebuke
description: Turn a blow aside from a firm stand and answer it before the attacker has recovered.

name: Root Sink
description: Sink qi down through the feet until no push or throw can move the body from its place.

name: Rooted Heave
description: Heave from the planted stance so the target is lifted and thrown clear of its own feet.

name: Rootfall Strike
description: Drive the whole rooted weight down through a fist so it lands with the force of a falling mass.

name: Unmoved Fist
description: Meet an attack with a fist that does not retreat and break it with the weight behind the planted leg.

name: Bearing Hand
description: Strike along a held bearing so that the blow is true and carries the body behind it.

name: Held Guard
description: Keep the arms fixed on the bearing and let blows wear against them without shifting the stance.

name: Slow Pace
description: Move slowly and surely along the bearing so the stance stays whole at every step.

name: Bearing Inhale
description: Draw qi into the limbs along the held bearing so strength builds the longer the stance is kept.

name: Bearingclasp
description: Hold the target's limb along the line of the bearing so it cannot turn or draw back.

name: Steadfast Blow
description: Throw a blow that does not waver in its line though the target dodges and resists.

name: Held Rebuke
description: Hold the bearing against a strike then return it at once along the same line.

name: Steadying Exhale
description: Draw one long breath and let qi carry the weakness of poison or strain out of the limbs.

name: Steadfast Ruin
description: Fall upon the target with the whole held bearing and ruin its guard and stance in one blow.

name: Anchored Blow
description: Drive a fist from a stance anchored so firmly that the force passes clean through the target.
